text:
Situation: Docetaxel 160 mg/8 mL is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 52 vials (21 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 81 vials (27.9 days on hand). Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC has a product listed as To Be Discontinued on the FDA shortage list with an initial posting date of 2026-02-20.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show docetaxel is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC has a product listed as To Be Discontinued on the FDA shortage list with an initial posting date of 2026-02-20.

Our position: Current inventory supports continued dispensing. The Ingenus discontinuation notice warrants proactive sourcing to maintain supply continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Accord Healthcare Inc. (not on FDA shortage list today; label names no plant we could place) — needs buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Actavis Pharma, Inc. as secondary source (not on FDA shortage list today; label names no plant we could place) — needs buyer and P&T approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. as tertiary source (not on FDA shortage list today; label names no plant we could place) — needs buyer and P&T approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly for status changes — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until inventory falls below 14 days on hand.
